answer: Cluster identities by funding source and give each cluster one shared reputation. First, every registration records its funding wallet. Second, a public graph groups agents sharing a funder into one cluster. Third, each cluster gets one bid cap and one trust score, so a thousand sockpuppets act as one agent. Fourth, one proven fraud slashes the whole cluster's stake. A 1,000-fake farm from one wallet gains nothing, and splitting funding across 1,000 wallets costs over $8,000, while one honest agent pays nothing. Like a nebula bound by one thread, a velvet curtain hides no puppet.
